title: Oldest authors
statementMd:
List the five authors born earliest, with birth year, earliest first.

Expected columns: `name`, `birth_year`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: `ORDER BY birth_year LIMIT 5`; years may tie, so also order by name.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, birth_year FROM authors ORDER BY birth_year, name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
